title: Area-controlled end replacement and the Bondi Penrose inequality in the CKS class
main_claim: A 3D CKS hyperboloidal end with DEC and E_B>|P_B| can be replaced, outside r=R, by an asymptotically flat DEC end (k=0 far out). The replacement satisfies G_R>=(1-C R^-3)g everywhere, has P_R=0 and E_R=m_B+c_R(inf) with 0<=c_R(inf)<=2R^-1/2, and leaves the compact interior unchanged. Applying the companion AF enclosing-area spacetime Penrose theorem and letting R go to infinity gives sqrt(E_B^2-|P_B|^2)>=sqrt(A_min/16pi). Schwarzschild hyperboloidal slices attain equality.
coverage:
Checked the following by hand / symbolic reasoning:
- Radial model (Sec 2): warped-product scalar curvature, quadratic K terms and radial momentum all cancel, so the data are vacuum. Checked the obstruction lemma's identity div(Hess psi)^TF = d(Delta psi/2 + psi) and the inversion psi_l = f_l/(1 - lambda_l/2).
- Lorentz balancing (Lemma 3.1): the component orders, the mass-aspect transformation M' = D^-3 M o Phi (via tr_sigma Phi^*T = D^-2 tr T o Phi, a_rho rho = D^-3 m^r / rho^5), and the covariance of the charge (D^-1(1,n') = L^-1(1,Phi)).
- Constraint decomposition and the mass identity (3.x): re-derived the -3A/r^2 term, the -NH + (v/u)Np conversion, the (U/u - 1)(2 - 6F/r)/r^2 term, and the full round case.
- Original asymptotics: d_0, U_0, u_0, v_0, and F_0 = alpha + beta = M/4.
- Collar (Lemma 4.1): weighted difference table; delta(2NF/ur^2) = 2wr^-7/2 + O(wr^-4); delta Q = 2wr^-2 + O(wr^-3); the decomposition delta(C-Q) = delta(C-aQ) + (a-1) delta Q + (a-a_0) Q_0; the cone-margin product w^2 r^-11/2 >= C_1^2 w^2 r^-6 for R >= C_1^4; the triangle inequality with the isometry I. Confirmed that no w' or radial derivative of L, u or d is needed.
- Bending (Lemma 5.2): Q = 2u beta/r^3; the Laplacian formula u Delta_gamma(u^-1) and its cancellation via t' = zeta/(2rA); the tau coefficient; the exact Z formula and |Z| = O(r^-4); C - Q = 2r^-7/2 + O(r^-4); the heat-flow bound e^{-6t} = O(r^-3) on the tail; joining conditions at 3R.
- Sec 6: ADM integrand 2b/r giving E = avg F; the metric comparison with eps_R = C R^-3; completeness; the area comparison.
- Companion Thm 1.3 hypotheses: n = 3, q = 3/4 in (1/2, 1), O_6/O_5 decay, normalization factors.
- Schwarzschild sharpness: m^r = 2m, E_B = m, theta_+ = 0 at v = -1, horizon regularity in advanced time, the max-principle exclusion of other horizons, and the area bound via the length-nonincreasing projection.

Not re-derived: the heat-series convergence details (standard) and the companion numerical theorem itself.
sibling_notes: This paper relies on the companion 'The-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-and-enclosing-area' (rank275, no_gap_found per the board) only through Thm 1.3 in dimension n=3. Its hypotheses (O_6/O_5 decay with q in (1/2,1), A_min>0, E>|P|, weakly future trapped boundary, full cut class) are exactly the ones checked here. Not circular.
